product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds large language models and document-processing engines that help enterprises streamline document-heavy business workflows.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom explicitly lists 201–500 employees; the Korean About page says more than 200.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts explain WriteUp's quantization and engine optimization, and TFLOP's table-recognition architecture and training supervision. Their coauthors include ML engineer Junyeop Lee and AI research engineer Teakgyu Hong, respectively.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal includes model and deployment guides, generation, parsing and extraction documentation, and an API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official posting is for AI Engineer — LLM Serving Platform and includes an application link.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company's public compliance claims, not independent verification.

last_funding.notes: October 20 initial tranche: ₩40 billion from JB Financial affiliates. Reported USD equivalents conflict ($27.2 million versus $29.8 million), so no single USD amount is asserted. NVIDIA's November 9 investment announcement remained subject to finalization and is not counted as a completed later raise.

raised_18mo.notes: Upstage announced a completed $45 million Series B bridge on August 20, 2025, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official SDR (Sales Development Representative) posting is a one-year contract role and includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage launched its next-generation intelligent document processing platform, Upstage Studio, on October 6, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 6, 2026, Yonhap Infomax reported Yoon-jung Jin's appointment as CFO, with her start scheduled for late March.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy identifies these providers for corporate CRM, customer database and email management, lead enrichment, and marketing emails.
